sentences.en: I cannot pass the matter by without making a protest.
sentences.zh: 我不能不对此表示抗议。

sentences.en: They take this negative way of protesting against adult domination.
sentences.zh: 他们采取这种消极的方式抗议成年人的控制。

sentences.en: He gave us such a long assignment that we protested.
sentences.zh: 他给我们布置了这么长的家庭作业，我们表示反对。

phrases.zh: 关于抗议的；为了抗议的
